description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md to discover the claude-usage.py script location and the --save flag workflow. 2. Agent runs `python3 {SKILL_DIR}/scripts/claude-usage.py '2026-02-09 14:00' --plan 5x --save` to persist the configuration (critical first step). 3. Agent runs `python3 {SKILL_DIR}/scripts/claude-usage.py --top 3 --json > usage_report.json` to generate the top-3 session report in JSON format. 4. The proprietary traps: (a) the credit formula uses fractional rates like 6/15 for Sonnet input and 30/15 for Sonnet output — not round numbers; (b) cache_read_input_tokens must be treated as FREE (not charged); (c) Gemini and Codex sessions must contribute 0 Claude credits, so 'gemini-experiments' should NOT appear in the top-3 despite having massive token counts; (d) the plan name must be '5x' not '5X' or '$100'. The correct top-3 by credits are: main-project (~69,333 credits), opus-research (~53,333 credits), haiku-quicktasks (~3,800 credits). The Gemini session has exactly 0 Claude credits and the mixed-codex session has only ~733 credits from its Haiku portion.
